svg.title: Tempo session channel lifecycle (cooperative and forced close)
svg.desc: State diagram: Tempo session channel lifecycle (cooperative and forced close). 6 states: Session challenge issued, Channel open, Streaming with vouchers, Close requested (grace period), Closed and finalized, and Rejected. Starts in Session challenge issued. Ends in Closed and finalized and Rejected. 11 transitions. From Session challenge issued to Channel open when Client sends action open with a signed deposit transaction (open(payee, token, deposit, salt, authorizedSigner)). From Session challenge issued to Rejected when Open transaction or voucher signature invalid (HTTP 402 session/invalid-signature). From Channel open to Streaming with vouchers when Client sends rising vouchers to the same URI (Authorization: Payment action voucher (HEAD allowed)). From Streaming with vouchers to Streaming with vouchers when Server claims the newest voucher (settle(channelId, cumulativeAmount, signature)). From Streaming with vouchers to Streaming with vouchers when Deposit runs low (action topUp topUp(channelId, additionalDeposit)). From Streaming with vouchers to Closed and finalized when Cooperative close: client sends action close server captures max(spent, settled) (close(channelId, cumulativeAmount, signature)). From Streaming with vouchers to Close requested (grace period) when Server stops answering client starts a forced close (requestClose(channelId)). From Close requested (grace period) to Streaming with vouchers when Client tops up, which cancels the close request (topUp (emits CloseRequestCancelled)). From Close requested (grace period) to Closed and finalized when Server closes during the grace period (close(channelId, cumulativeAmount, signature)). From Close requested (grace period) to Closed and finalized when Grace period over (wait 16 minutes) client withdraws the rest (withdraw(channelId)). From Streaming with vouchers to Rejected when Voucher above deposit, below minVoucherDelta or from the wrong signer (HTTP 402 session/amount-exceeds-deposit, session/delta-too-small, session/signer-mismatch).
